outcome.answer: Paper [1] directly addresses this: it gives a high-probability, all-time upper bound on the actor’s distance from the optimal parameter in a two-timescale actor–critic setup. With probability at least 1−ε₁−ε₂, the actor error remains within the stated bound for every k ≥ n₀, after a sufficiently large n₀; the bound depends on k, n₀, and ε₁, ε₂. [1]
